settings.label: t:settings_schema.logo.settings.logo_width.label
settings.info: Desktop logo width. With the rope logo, this is the width on screens 990px and wider.

settings.label: Hang the rope from the announcement bar
settings.info: Places the logo on the left of the header with its letters centred, and lets the rope at the top of the image run up behind the announcement bar so it looks tied to it. Use a transparent PNG with the rope at the top edge.

settings.label: Drop-in animation on the homepage
settings.info: On each fresh load of the homepage the logo drops from above the screen along the rope and settles with a small swing. Skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Logo width on tablet
settings.info: Screens 750–989px wide.

settings.label: Logo width on mobile
settings.info: Screens under 750px wide.

settings.label: Rope position across the logo
settings.info: Where the rope sits, from the logo's left edge. The logo swings around this point.

settings.label: Rope length above the letters
settings.info: Share of the logo's height that is rope only, from the top edge of the image down to the top of the letters. The rope always starts at the bottom of the announcement bar; this keeps the letters centred in the header.

settings.label: Space below the letters
settings.info: Share of the logo's height below the letters (for example a tassel hanging lower). Leave at 0% if the letters reach the bottom of the image.

settings.label: Note under the estimate
settings.default: You'll see EGP at checkout. Your bank converts it automatically.

settings.content: Layered PNG images for the Design Your Own preview. Export every layer from the same square canvas as the mannequin, in white yarn on a transparent background (except the mannequin), and they line up at 0 / 0 / 100%. Layers are tinted with the customer's colors; any layer left empty keeps the drawn version. Inner ear layers follow their outer ears, and their own sliders adjust on top.
